headings.styles: Tracking-tight for large text. Use font-black or font-light for extreme contrast.
headings.rules: DO NOT use Inter for headings. Implement masked line-by-line reveal for Hero H1 using framer-motion.

colors.rules: Never use pure black or pure white. Tint black with blue. Do not use generic full-screen gradients. Apply glowing shadows on primary interactive elements.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: High-end crystal glass. Use 'bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-lg' for cards and sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadows with primary/cyan colors for buttons and hover states. e.g., 'hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]'.
visual_enhancers.gradient_borders: Use the 'Tracing Beam' or animated gradient borders on premium feature cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.02) over the main background to eliminate digital flatness.

component_rules.navigation: Floating glass header (fixed, z-50). MUST have backdrop-blur-xl and semi-transparent bg. Do NOT use completely transparent background. Keep links visible on desktop.
component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Default state: solid primary or subtle glass. Hover state: animated glow, text color explicit, scale up slightly (scale-105).
component_rules.cards: Frosted glass cards. No default solid colors. Must have 1px semi-transparent border to separate from background.
component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn components but override default styling. Inputs should have 'bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:border-cyan-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-400'.
component_rules.dashboard: High density grid. Surfaces can be slightly more opaque for data readability but maintain the tech/glass theme. Use Shadcn datatables and charts.

grids.marketing: Asymmetric 'Tetris' Bento grids. gap-8 to gap-12. Span logic mixing tall, wide, and square cells.
grids.dashboard: Strict high-density grid (grid-cols-4 or 12). gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
grids.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. Generous padding inside bordered glass containers to avoid text collisions.

layouts.hero: Kinetic, subtle parallax background. Numbered manifesto chapters. Center content for high impact or heavily asymmetric. Include 'Empowering Future Tech Leaders' tagline.
layouts.sections: Separated by massive padding (py-24 or py-32). Incorporate a slow editorial marquee (e.g., using react-fast-marquee) for tech partners/courses.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and forms. Center-align hero titles only if balanced.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load (framer-motion variants with y: 100%, opacity: 0 to y: 0, opacity: 1).
motion.scroll_reveal: Staggered fade-up for bento grid cards.
motion.interactions: Hover lifts (-translate-y-1), glowing borders on hover. Micro-interactions for buttons.
motion.parallax: Subtle framer-motion useScroll / useTransform for hero images and background abstract elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glass meets APCA standards. Use text-shadow if needed over complex backgrounds.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for heavy parallax or marquee.

media.style: High-contrast, tech-focused, cinematic. Dark overlays (bg-black/40) on background images so text remains readable.
media.logo_rules: Always use the provided company logo. Do not substitute with text.

3d_libraries: framer-motion for 2.5D parallax. react-fast-marquee for marquee. lucide-react and @phosphor-icons/react for icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @studio-freight/lenis, react-fast-marquee, @phosphor-icons/react, sonner.
Project uses standard React (.js), so write JSX in .js files, NOT .tsx.
Ensure dark mode is the default and enforced to support the glowing glassmorphism aesthetic.
Implement the 'Awwwards-level' kinetic hero: Use framer-motion to create a staggered, line-by-line text reveal for the H1 tag.
Build a slow editorial marquee using 'react-fast-marquee' containing tech keywords or course categories. Style it with transparent backgrounds and glowing borders.
Implement the navigation bar as a floating, sticky crystal glass header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 border-b border-white/10).
For the admin dashboard, prioritize high density and clarity, but retain the dark tech theme. Use customized Shadcn tables, forms, and dialogs with glass elements.
All cards must have a 1px border-white/10 and subtle inner shadow to pop from the background.
When displaying the provided logo, ensure it has a proper alt tag and is sized appropriately.
Create numbered manifesto chapters (e.g., '01 / INNOVATION', '02 / LEADERSHIP') separated by large padding, utilizing scroll-triggered fade-ups.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
